title: His first drum set and the old wooden equipment
summary: The first set had a narrow two-headed bass drum and a wooden snare and pedal; he later bought a new set.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: You say that first drum set you had with the old overhead pedal, how long did you have that set?
Well, I didn't keep that long. I didn't keep that long. I felt like they gave me that set.
And then what did you do?
I got the real new style pedals after.
Well, did you get a new set of drums?
New set, I got a whole new, yeah, I got that new set I bought from Coins. That's what the set I bought from Coins. Oh, I see.
Well, what would be the make on that old style drum you had? Did you have any make on it?
No, but I mean, it was made different altogether. The bass drum was made more narrow, you know. It wasn't... Oh. It wasn't the biggest. The bass drum was all about to say like that, I mean.
Uh-huh. It had two heads on it?
Two heads, yeah. They had an overhead beat, I mean, wooden pedal.
I guess it'd have a narrow snare drum too, would it?
Well, the snare drum wasn't much different. The wooden snare drum, it didn't have no metal snare drum. No. Wooden snare drum. The snare drum was just like the bass drum. Yeah.
I mean, you take like today, you couldn't play them in wooden pedals like that, like they play in the day, I mean.
No, I hope. It was fast enough.
